book.name: Hibru
book.title: Leta I Wa Weŋgiya Hibru Jisas Gha Ghambu Utuniye

content: Jisas, Loi Nariye, i Laghɨye kivwalaŋgiya Nyao Thovuthovuye
Mevivako me mbaŋa tomethi na e kamwathɨ tomethi tɨnenji, orumburumbunda thɨ loŋweya Loi le utu weŋgiya ghalɨŋae gharautu,

ko iyemaeŋge e mbaŋake iyake, iye mbaŋa momouniye, ra loŋweya Loi le utu weya Nariye. Weya amalaghɨniye Loi va i vakathaŋgiya yambaneke na buruburu, na iye Loi kaerova i tuthi na bigibigike wolaghɨye inawe ne i mbaroŋa.

Iye Loi le vwenyevwenye manjamanjalawae na iye ŋgoreiye moliya Loi. Iye le utuutuko ele vurɨgheghe na i vakatha bigibigike wolaghɨye mbe inanjiwe vara. Amalaghɨniye i mare na i thavwiyathu gharɨgharɨ lenji tharɨ ko mbaŋa i vakathavao iyako, i voro e buruburu na i yaku Loi Vurɨvurɨghegheniye Moli valɨvaŋga e uneko.
Loi va i vakatha Nariye na i laghɨye kivwalaŋgiya nyao thovuthovuye, ŋgoreiya idako iya Loi va i unogiyakowe i laghɨye kivwala nyao thovuthovuye idanji.
Ŋgoreiyako kaiwae Loi mava mbaŋa regha i dage weya le nyaoko thovuthovuye regha na iŋa,

content.text: “Ghen Naruŋgwa ghen; na noroke ya tabona Ramanɨna ghino.”

content: Na amalaghɨniye utuniye Loi tembe iŋava:

content.text: “Ghino ne ya tabo Ramae na amalaghɨniye Naruŋgu.”

content: Tembe ŋgoreiyeva mbaŋa Loi i variya Nariye ghagamau e yambaneke, amba iŋa, “Lo nyaoko thovuthovuye wolaghɨye ne thɨ kururuwe.”
Le nyao thovuthovuye kaiwanji Loi iŋa:

content.text: “Ya vakathaŋgiya lo nyao thovuthovuye rakakaiwo ŋgoranjiya ndewendewe na ndɨghe mamiye.”
“Mbema Loiya ghen, len ghamba mbarona i meghabana ma ele ghambako;
wein ghanɨthanavu rumwaru u mbaroŋaŋgi na thovuye len gharɨgharɨ.
U warariŋa thanavu i rumwaru na u botewoyathu thanavu raitharɨ,
iya kaiwae wein len warari laghɨye, ghino len Loi ya liŋgiya bunama e umbalɨna na ya vaŋguraweŋge u mbaroŋaŋgiya ghanunena.”

content: Loi tembe i dageweva Nariye iŋa:

content.text: “Giya, va i rikowe ghen u vakatha yambaneke, na buruburuko ghen nɨman muiye.
Yambaneke na buruburu ne thɨko, ko iyemaeŋge ghen u meghabana.
Thiye ne thɨ tharɨ ŋgoreiya kwama ghambɨghambɨ i ghambɨ na i vwatha.
Tene u vaghɨleŋgi ŋgoreiya thɨ senisiya ghanjikwama.
Ko ghen ma u totomethi, na yawalina ma ele ghambako.”

content: Loi ma mbaŋa regha i dage weya le nyao thovuthovuye regha na iŋa:

content.text: “U yaku gheke, valɨvaŋga e uneŋguke ghaghada ne ya biginjoŋaŋgiya ghanɨthɨghɨya e gheghenɨna raberabe.”

content: Ko nyao thovuthovuye thavalaŋgi? Thiye nyaoŋgi thɨ kaiwo weya Loi na i varivariye weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ kaero thɨ vaidiya vamoru na thɨ thalavuŋgi.
